hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom curve by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap: takes input tokens, wraps or unwraps via the phiEth contract, settles output to the PoolManager, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Liquidity additions are permanently blocked via beforeAddLiquidity revert.
